SRC-005:R001.text: CORE-001: P1 wintage.user.js theme-switch reload survival equates 'location.reload() did not throw' with 'the old document will unload': a cancelled beforeunload leaves the old palette painted while GM_setValue already persisted the new one, with no pending-theme row or warning.

SRC-005:R002.text: CORE-002: P1 setupRouteGuard commits the __wintageRouteGuard boolean latch before any hook installs; one transient pushState/replaceState/listener failure permanently suppresses reinjection repair, so same-document pushState can enter OAuth/captcha/payment excluded routes unguarded.

SRC-005:R003.text: CORE-003: P1 targets.ps1 Restore-DirPreState returns success when Existed=true and SnapshotPath is missing, and deletes the authoritative snapshot from an unconditional finally on materialization failure, so Invoke-TargetCommit can claim exact pre-operation state after a failed rollback.

SRC-005:R004.text: CORE-004: P2 import-fastprompter.js --check exits 0 printing 'no FastPrompter source available - freshness check skipped' under the exact release.ps1 invocation, so a hand-edited or stale imported theme pack passes the release freshness gate that exists to catch it.

SRC-005:R005.text: W2-001: P1 Invoke-Obsidian multi-vault Apply/Revert rolls back only the currently failing vault: earlier mutated vaults stay themed on a failed Apply (or keep consumed recovery on a failed Revert), the manifest never advances, and per-vault rollback errors are swallowed by empty catches.

SRC-005:R006.text: W2-002: P1 many handlers still mutate live state before Invoke-TargetCommit despite the repaired invariant: Total Commander legacy Revert/Apply, SmartVac Revert/Apply, WildRift, SAIPENVIEW, BetterDiscord, generic extension Revert in install.ps1, the browser dispatch child path, and the Windows theme helper interval.

SRC-005:R007.text: W2-003: P1 SmartVac, WildRift and SAIPENVIEW Revert commit blocks remove the manifest entry before the fallible backup deletion, so a failure after removal restores the target while the manifest entry is permanently gone -- scriptblock grouping is not atomicity.

SRC-005:R008.text: W2-004: P1 recovery artifacts and provenance are written directly to final names (Write-Utf8/File WriteAllText) and later gated by Test-Path existence: a crash mid first-touch/rebase poisons the authoritative recovery state instead of failing closed.
